Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent
Eloquent models: one class per table over the query builder, in the style of Laravel's Eloquent.

A model extends Model, declares a ModelQuery entry and overrides the protected configuration methods it needs: 


 public final class User extends Model {
     public static final ModelQuery<User> query = ModelQuery.of(User.class, User::new);

     protected List<String> fillable() {
         return Arrays.asList("name", "email");
     }

     protected RelationMap<?> relations() {
         return RelationMap.of(User.class).add("posts", User::posts);
     }

     public HasMany<Post> posts() {
         return hasMany(Post.class);
     }
 }

 User user = User.query.on(db).create(attributes);
 ModelCollection<User> users = User.query.on(db).with("posts").get();

This package holds the model, its builder, collection and page types, and their exceptions. It does not hold SQL: every statement goes through the core query builder, so the SQL is the builder's. Casts live in eloquent.casts, the JSON codec in eloquent.json and the relation types in eloquent.relations; eloquent.internal bridges the packages and is not API. Scopes, soft deletes and event dispatchers are not here yet; the protected hook methods on the model are the place they will attach.

Beyond reading and writing relations, a query adds relation aggregates as columns (withCount, withMax, withMin, withSum, withAvg, withExists, withAggregate) and loaded models get them with the load* methods; withCasts and mergeCasts add casts to one query's models or one instance; touches() names the owners a save or delete touches, and withoutTouching turns that off for named classes on the calling thread for one call; push() saves a model and its loaded relations. Touching and push() visit each model once per call and never lazy load. touchOwners(), push() and toMap() recurse once per level of the loaded graph, so a very deep chain can overflow a small thread stack.

A model declares a many-to-many relation with one of the protected belongsToMany factories, which return a BelongsToMany. Each related model it returns holds the joining row as a Pivot, read with Pivot.of(model).

A related model's class must have run its static initialiser before a relation names it, because a class literal such as Post.class does not run it. Touch each model's query entry at startup.
